cross_rules.economic_rationale: Trend must be confirmed by participation, volume, liquidity or path quality.
Reversal is conditioned on pressure, gap geometry or an observable volatility extreme.
Direction mechanism changes only when a causal volatility or path regime changes.
A base market signal may be filtered by volatility, credit or financial stress.
Slow valuation or macro state combines only with market trend, rates or credit.
Market direction is confirmed by broad public factor and industry participation.
SPY state may interact with bonds, currencies, commodities and global risk signals.
Only preregistered public releases or events may condition a pre-existing market state.
Ensembles combine a small number of distinct simple mechanisms.
Trend or reversal may be conditioned on causal scale, entropy, cycle or path structure.
Price signals may interact with liquidity, financing, positioning and aggregate flows.
Models receive only approved causal inputs and retain the global five-feature cap.
Volatility and positioning families may form a bounded risk-sentiment composite.
Forecast combinations mix frozen outputs using only past error or bounded voting weights.

deterministic_nyse_calendar_rule(calendar_rule,hold,target_weekday,target_month); rules=turn_of_month|month_end|quarter_end|weekday|month|sell_in_may

select first components=3|5 from component_set diversified=(F003,-F021,-F032,F039,F046), trend=(F001,F003,F006,F044,F046), contrarian=(F009,F010,F022,F039,F049), or macro=(F003,-F032,-F033,F039,F049); majority=mean(sign(component)), unanimity=common sign else 0, median=median(trailing_z(component,normalization_window)), weighted_vote=sum(sign(component)/trailing_std(diff(component),normalization_window))/sum(1/trailing_std); every component is as-of joined at or before decision date

base map trend=sign(F003), reversal=sign(F009), breakout=sign(F006), ensemble=sign(F051); bullish gate map volatility=-sign(F015), vix=-sign(F021), credit=-sign(F032), macro=sign(F035), liquidity=sign(F020); require identical nonzero gate sign for confirmation sessions; and=base if gate bullish else -1, or=+1 if base or gate bullish else -1, override=confirmed_gate unless zero else base, switch=base if gate nonnegative else -base; all inputs as-of joined

at each monthly|quarterly refit use only prior window rows from feature_set diversified_3=(F003,F021,F032), diversified_5=(F003,F009,F021,F032,F039), market_5=(F001,F003,F009,F015,F021), macro_5=(F003,F032,F033,F039,F049), or breadth_5=(F003,F021,F044,F046,F048); standardize on that trailing sample, initialize deterministic k-means centers at equally spaced quantiles of projection on vector (1..p), run at most 40 Lloyd iterations, assign clusters=2|3|4 and store mean known next-session SPY return per cluster; output current cluster stored mean; target for row t is trained only from feature rows through t-1 whose next-session close is already known at t

observation=(known_previous_SPY_return and ar_order lags,F015,F021,F032); at each monthly|quarterly refit standardize prior window only, form risk=(-return+sum(other standardized observations))/sqrt(p), discretize into states=2|3 by trailing quantiles, estimate Laplace-smoothed transition matrix plus per-state Gaussian risk likelihood and known next-session-return mean; recursively filter current state probability using only previous posterior and current known observation; emit probability-weighted state return when max posterior>=probability else 0

composite=mean(trailing_z(F003,window),trailing_z(-F021,window),trailing_z(-F032,window)); cusum uses two-sided cumulative deviations with drift=penalty/10, page_hinkley uses causal running mean and delta=penalty/20, causal_pelt uses prefix-only penalized least-squares segmentation with maximum segment window; output signed bounded shift score and optionally reset CUSUM or Page-Hinkley after threshold; no historical output is revised after future append

rolling binary GLM on the frozen feature_set choices from F053; target=1(next-session SPY return>0), training rows stop at t-1, features are standardized on prior window, intercept is unpenalized and slopes use L2 ridge; logit maximizes Bernoulli logistic likelihood and probit uses normal-CDF Bernoulli likelihood with deterministic L-BFGS-B; refit monthly|quarterly and emit predicted_probability-threshold

rolling model on the frozen feature_set choices from F053 with known next-session direction target and no row t target in its own fit; PLS performs deterministic NIPALS deflation for components and clips its probability to [0,1]; GAM builds per-feature linear plus positive hinge bases at knots equally spaced training quantiles and fits ridge-logit; standardization and knots use prior window only, refit monthly|quarterly, output probability-threshold

rolling classifier on the frozen feature_set choices from F053 and known next-session direction target; tree recursively chooses deterministic decile thresholds minimizing squared Bernoulli error to depth; boosted_stumps uses AdaBoost with deterministic weighted best stumps, estimators and learning_rate; fit sees only prior window and refits monthly|quarterly, output probability-threshold

at each monthly|quarterly refit standardize prior window of a frozen F053 feature_set, create bullish literals feature>its trailing threshold_quantile and their negations, enumerate deterministic identity|not|and|or|majority|score expressions up to depth, select highest prior next-session direction accuracy with lexicographic tie break, freeze expression until next refit and emit +1|-1; row t target is never used to select row t expression

deterministic controls from SPY information available at t: always_long=+1, always_short=-1, sma200=sign(close/rolling_mean_200(close)-1), momentum252=sign(return_252), rev2=-sign(return_2), inverse=-sign(previous_session_return), block_placebo=sign of fixed seed linear-congruential block index independent of returns; non-placebo desired state is sampled every hold sessions and carried forward

r_t=diff(log(close_t)); KAMA uses ER_t=abs(close_t-close_{t-window})/sum_{i=t-window+1}^t abs(diff(close_i)) and alpha_t=(ER_t*(2/3-2/31)+2/31)^2; VIDYA uses alpha_t=2/(window+1)*abs(sum(positive_diff)-sum(negative_diff))/sum(abs(diff)); FRAMA splits the last 2*floor(window/2) closes, D_t=(log(N1+N2)-log(N3))/log(2), alpha_t=clip(exp(-4.6*(D_t-1)),0.01,1); adaptive_t=adaptive_{t-1}+alpha_t*(close_t-adaptive_{t-1}); raw_t=log(close_t/adaptive_t)/rolling_std(r_t,window,ddof=0); value_t=sign(raw_t)*max(abs(raw_t)-threshold,0)

for every t use only y=log(close) rows t-window:t and reset a causal Kalman filter; local_level has state [level], local_trend [level,slope], kalman_slope [level,slope,acceleration]; transition F[i,j]=1/(j-i)! for j>=i, observation H=[1,0,...], R=var(diff(y),ddof=0), Q=R*noise_ratio*diag(1,0.1,0.01), initial state=[y_first,0,...], P=100*R*I; value is respectively last filtered level change, filtered slope, or slope+0.5*acceleration divided by sqrt(R), clipped to [-10,10]

apply past-only undecimated filters to r_t=diff(log(close_t)); at scale j use dilation 2^(j-1), detail d_jt=sum_k g_k*a_{j-1,t-k*dilation}/sqrt(2), approximation a_jt=sum_k h_k*a_{j-1,t-k*dilation}/sqrt(2); Haar h=[0.7071067811865476,0.7071067811865476], g=[0.7071067811865476,-0.7071067811865476]; db2 h=[0.4829629131445341,0.8365163037378079,0.2241438680420134,-0.1294095225512604], g=[-0.1294095225512604,-0.2241438680420134,0.8365163037378079,-0.4829629131445341]; db4 uses the frozen eight-tap h/g vectors in advanced_feature_engine; causal_modwt d_jt=(sum(last 2^(j-1) returns)-sum(previous 2^(j-1) returns))/sqrt(2^j); over window, energy=sign(sum_j d_jt)*sqrt(sum_j mean(d_j^2)/mean(r^2)), sign=sum_j sign(d_jt)*mean(d_j^2)/sum_j mean(d_j^2), slope=OLS_slope(a_scales)/std(r), reconstruction=sum_j d_jt/std(r)

on each trailing window of r_t=diff(log(close_t)), remove its mean or one-sided OLS line, set omega=2*pi/period and compute the single DFT coefficient by Goertzel recurrence s_n=x_n+2*cos(omega)*s_{n-1}-s_{n-2}, C=s_last-cos(omega)*s_prev+i*sin(omega)*s_prev; next-cycle forecast=2/window*Re(C*exp(i*omega*window)); phase coherence is abs(mean(C_b/abs(C_b))) across three contiguous detrended blocks after rotating each coefficient to the full-window origin; value=0 below phase_stability, otherwise forecast/std(window_returns)*coherence

take the trailing window of known log returns, retain the subsequence ending at t with stride lag and encode sign as 0|1; binary_entropy is normalized Shannon entropy -sum(p*log2(p)); lempel_ziv greedily parses the shortest unseen binary phrase and normalizes phrase_count*log2(n)/n clipped to [0,1]; orientation=sign(sum(last lag returns)), reversed only when direction=reversal; value=orientation*(1-complexity)

encode each known return in the trailing window as +1 if nonnegative else -1; current context is the last order signs; count only historical occurrences inside that same window whose following sign is already known by t; initialize positive and negative counts with smoothing and emit (positive_count-negative_count)/(positive_count+negative_count) as the causal next-sign forecast

compute bins-1 empirical quantiles from the trailing window of known returns and map every return to its causal ordinal bin; current context is the last order bins; count only same-context historical transitions whose target bin is known by t, initialize each target-bin count with smoothing, and emit the smoothed expected target rank using evenly spaced bin scores from -1 to +1

on 100*diff(log(close)) fit rolling causal ARMA(p,q) by six conditional-least-squares iterations: initialize innovations to zero, regress r_t on intercept, p lagged returns and q lagged innovations with ridge 1e-8 on non-intercept coefficients using stable augmented least squares; after every iteration clip the intercept to five trailing standard deviations and project the AR and MA blocks separately so each sum(abs(coefficients))<=0.98, then recompute innovations recursively; freeze coefficients between weekly|monthly refits; forecast t+1 from returns and innovations known at t, clip to five trailing standard deviations, divide by 100

demean the trailing window of 100*diff(log(close)); fit GARCH(p,q), GJR-GARCH(p,q) or EGARCH(p,q) by deterministic L-BFGS-B quasi maximum likelihood with transformed persistence below 0.995, 40 iterations and parameter bounds [-6,6]; normal or standardized Student-t likelihood uses fixed student_df; GARCH h_t=omega+sum(alpha_i*e_{t-i}^2)+sum(beta_j*h_{t-j}), GJR adds sum(gamma_i*e_{t-i}^2*I[e<0]), EGARCH log(h_t)=omega+sum(alpha_i*(abs(z)-Eabs(z))+gamma_i*z)+sum(beta_j*log(h)); coefficients refit monthly|quarterly, one-step variance uses only e and h through t, value=log(forecast_variance/mean(window_residual_squared))

daily variance is close=diff(log(close))^2, Parkinson=log(high/low)^2/(4*log(2)), Garman-Klass=0.5*log(high/low)^2-(2*log(2)-1)*log(close/open)^2, or Rogers-Satchell=log(high/open)*log(high/close)+log(low/open)*log(low/close); build HAR state from trailing means over horizons 1,5,22 or 1,5,22,63; at each monthly|quarterly refit use exactly window prior states with already-known next-session variance targets and ridge 1e-8 OLS; forecast next variance from state t; log mode emits predicted_log_variance-log(current_22_day_variance), level mode emits predicted_variance/current_22_day_variance-1

daily-sampling proxy only, not intraday realised variation: r_t=diff(log(close)); positive_t=rolling_mean(r_t^2*I[r_t>=0],window), negative_t=rolling_mean(r_t^2*I[r_t<0],window), bp_t=(pi/2)*abs(r_t)*abs(r_{t-1}), rs_t=log(high/open)*log(high/close)+log(low/open)*log(low/close); semivariance_imbalance=(positive-negative)/(positive+negative), bipower_share=sign(rolling_sum(r))*rolling_mean(bp)/(rolling_mean(bp)+rolling_mean(rs)), jump_proxy=rolling_sum(sign(r)*max(rs-bp,0))/rolling_sum(rs)

compute daily close, Parkinson, Garman-Klass and Rogers-Satchell variance exactly as frozen in F070, take each trailing window mean and its log; dispersion=population_std(across four log estimates), max_min_ratio=max(log_estimates)-min(log_estimates), close_vs_range=log(close_variance/mean(Parkinson,Garman-Klass,Rogers-Satchell)); all inputs end at t

range_t=max(high_t-low_t,epsilon), body_t=close_t-open_t, orientation_t=sign(body_t) when abs(body_t)/range_t>=tolerance else 0; over length 2..5 direction_run=mean(orientation), engulfing=orientation_t only when the current real body contains every prior real body, wick_reversal=mean((lower_wick-upper_wick)/range), range_breakout=clipped excess of close_t beyond the high or low of the previous length-1 bars after tolerance; reversal multiplies the selected value by -1

a high or low at index j is a pivot only after pivot_span later bars confirm it against the symmetric 2*pivot_span+1 neighborhood; at t retain only pivots with confirmation_index<=t and j in [t-window,t); nearest_balance=(distance_to_nearest_resistance-distance_to_nearest_support)/(sum_distances), touch_imbalance=(support_pivots_within_tolerance-resistance_pivots_within_tolerance)/total_touches, breakout_pressure=2*(close_t-midpoint(prior_window_high,prior_window_low))/(prior_window_range) clipped to [-2,2]

fit a past-only degree 2 or 3 polynomial by OLS to the last window log closes on x in [-1,0]; evaluate end-point slope=c1/(window-1), acceleration=2*c2/(window-1)^2 and divide by std(diff(log_close)); convexity=acceleration/(std_return*(1+(slope/std_return)^2)^(3/2)); exhaustion=-sign(slope)*acceleration/std_return; clip every value to [-20,20]

r_t=diff(log(close)), v_t=diff(log(volume)); for each t pair exactly window known observations of leader_{s-lag} with target_s, where leader/target are volume/return or return/volume, and compute Pearson correlation; correlation returns that relation, predictive_score multiplies it by the current leader z-score from its trailing window and clips to [-10,10]

explicit bar-volume proxy, never order flow: signed_volume_t=sign(diff(log(close_t)))*volume_t; imbalance=rolling_sum(signed_volume)/rolling_sum(volume), obv_slope=(cumulative_signed_volume_t-cumulative_signed_volume_{t-window+1})/((window-1)*rolling_mean(volume)), pressure=tanh(rolling_mean(sign(return)*log1p(volume/rolling_median(volume))))

daily estimators only: Roll spread ratio=2*sqrt(max(-rolling_cov(diff(close_t),diff(close_{t-1})),0))/rolling_mean(close); Corwin-Schultz uses beta=log(H_t/L_t)^2+log(H_{t-1}/L_{t-1})^2, gamma=log(max(H_t,H_{t-1})/min(L_t,L_{t-1}))^2, alpha=max((sqrt(2*beta)-sqrt(beta))/(3-2*sqrt(2))-sqrt(gamma/(3-2*sqrt(2))),0), spread=2*(exp(alpha)-1)/(1+exp(alpha)) then trailing mean; Amihud=rolling_mean(1e6*abs(log_return)/(close*volume))

observable daily liquidity states, not share-turnover: zero_return_rate=rolling_mean(I[abs(log_return)*10000<=zero_tolerance_bps]); volume_drought=max(rolling_median(log(close*volume))-log(close*volume),0); volume_shock=abs(log(close*volume)-rolling_median(log(close*volume)))/rolling_std(log(close*volume))

base_score=tanh(log(close_t/close_{t-base_window})/(rolling_std(log_return,base_window)*sqrt(base_window))) and is negated for reversal; liquidity stress is the causal Roll, Corwin-Schultz or volume_drought series using liquidity_window; stress_percentile_t is the causal midrank mean(stress<current)+0.5*mean(stress==current) inside its trailing liquidity_window; confirmed_t requires stress_percentile<=stress_quantile for confirmation consecutive rows; gate emits base_score*confirmed, attenuate emits base_score*confirmed*(1-stress_percentile)

declared aggregate-flow proxy, not ETF creations/redemptions: daily component=sign(log_return)*rolling_z(log(close*volume),daily_window); on native delayed Z.1 dates balance_level=(household_equity_share+mutual_fund_equity_share)/2 and balance_score=rolling_z(diff(balance_level,balance_lag),balance_window); on native FINRA dates margin_score=rolling_z(diff(log(margin_debit_to_credit),margin_lag),margin_window); align the two sparse scores backward to each SPY decision date only after availability and combine weights equal=(1/3,1/3,1/3), financing=(0.25,0.25,0.5), allocation=(0.25,0.5,0.25)

on FINRA monthly releases let ratio=log(margin_debit/margin_credit); level=rolling_z(ratio,window), change=rolling_z(diff(ratio,lag),window), debit_growth=rolling_z(diff(log(margin_debit),lag),window), percentile=2*causal_midrank(ratio over window)-1; contrarian multiplies the selected state by -1; output remains on native release dates with the documented second-month tenth-session lag

declared CFTC futures positioning proxy, not consolidated short interest or days-to-cover: on Friday-available weekly reports use noncommercial_short_pct_oi, reportable_short_pct_oi, or rolling_z(diff((noncommercial_short_pct_oi+reportable_short_pct_oi)/2,lag),window); level variants are rolling z-scores; continuation maps rising short pressure negative and contrarian maps it positive

declared aggregate-flow proxy: compute native-frequency rolling z-scores of one-period change in mean Z.1 household/mutual-fund equity share, FINRA log margin-debit-to-credit and CFTC noncommercial net percent of open interest; align delayed Z.1 and FINRA states backward to each Friday-available CFTC date; aggregate_flow=mean(all three), financing_pressure=mean(margin,positioning), allocation_pressure=mean(balance,positioning), disagreement=mean(all)*(1-clip(population_std(all),0,2)/2)

end-of-day redesign, never an auction/order-book imbalance: close_location=(2*close-high-low)/(high-low), range_score=rolling_z(log(high-low),window), volume_score=rolling_z(log(volume),window); close_location emits the level, range_volume_pressure=close_location*tanh((range_score+volume_score)/2), signed_volume_shock=close_location*abs(volume_score), persistence=rolling_mean(close_location,window)

redesigned weekly participation proxy, not option volume by type: gap=(CFTC_futures_and_options_open_interest-CFTC_futures_only_open_interest)/combined_open_interest clipped [0,1]; participation_gap emits the raw gap, change=rolling_z(diff(gap,lag),window), volume_scaled=change_score*(1+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(log(SPY_volume_aligned_to_release),window)))

proxy only, no buyer initiation or option delta buckets: noncommercial_gap=CFTC_combined_noncommercial_net_pct_oi-futures_only_noncommercial_net_pct_oi and commercial_gap analogously emit raw percentage-point gaps; gap_change=rolling_z(diff(noncommercial_gap,lag),window); open_interest_share=(combined_open_interest-futures_open_interest)/combined_open_interest clipped [0,1]; negate the selected value only for contrarian

observable CFTC concentration only, never option strikes or walls: top4_level and top8_level are rolling z-scores of absolute combined net top-four/top-eight concentration; top4_top8_share=clip(abs(top4_combined)/abs(top8_combined),0,2); combined_gap=rolling_z(abs(top4_combined)-abs(top4_futures),window); change=rolling_z(diff(abs(top8_combined)-abs(top8_futures),lag),window)

redesign without strike-surface claims: vix_close is the contemporaneously public 30-day bridge, equal to VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX from that date; recalculated pre-publication VIX history is forbidden; before next-session projection, isolated missing official closes are filled only from an already observed close for at most 5 source rows; disagreement=log(vix_close/VXO), disagreement_state=rolling_z(disagreement+diff(disagreement,change_lag),window); downside and upside are rolling sums of squared SPY log returns by sign, realized_asymmetry=(downside-upside)/(downside+upside), asymmetry_state=rolling_z(realized_asymmetry,window); composite=(disagreement_state+asymmetry_state)/2, divergence=disagreement_state-asymmetry_state; contrarian negates the selected output

realized common-correlation proxy, never a Cboe implied-correlation index: for each industry compute a trailing-window z-return with at least ceil(0.9*window) observations; at each date retain available z-returns only and require at least max(2,ceil(0.8*N_total)) industries; daily_pair_product=((sum_i z_i)^2-sum_i z_i^2)/(N_available*(N_available-1)); common_correlation is its trailing-window mean with at least ceil(0.9*window) observations, clipped [-1,1], and remains unavailable before row 2*window-2; variance_gap=(VIX/100)^2-252*rolling_mean(SPY_log_return^2,window); correlation_state and variance_state are rolling z-scores; correlation_gap=correlation_state-variance_state, interaction=correlation_state*variance_state clipped [-20,20]

close-to-close redesign without VVIX or SKEW claims: vol30 is the contemporaneously public bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter, never recalculated pre-publication VIX; vol_of_vol=sqrt(252)*rolling_std(diff(log(vol30)),window); methodology_disagreement=log(vol30/VXO); causal tail cutoff at t is quantile(SPY log returns t-window...t-1,tail_quantile), realized_tail=sqrt(252*rolling_mean(return^2*I(return<=cutoff),window)); convexity_interaction=rolling_z(vol_of_vol,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(realized_tail,window))+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(abs(methodology_disagreement),window))) clipped [-20,20]

declared daily proxy, not an intraday jump estimator or option-implied expected return; implied variance uses the contemporaneously public vol30 bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter: RV=252*rolling_mean(SPY_log_return^2,window); BV=252*pi/2*rolling_mean(abs(return_t)*abs(return_t-1),window); jump=max(RV-BV,0); variance_premium=(vol30/100)^2-RV; continuous_premium=(vol30/100)^2-BV; jump_share=clip(jump/RV,0,1); risk_compensation=rolling_z(variance_premium,window)*(1+jump_share) clipped [-20,20]

tail-insurance proxy only, never an OTM put wing; implied volatility uses the contemporaneously public vol30 bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter: compute realized_tail and tail_realization=tail_variance/total_realized_variance from the F091 causal tail rule; implied_downside_gap=log((vol30/100)/realized_tail); on native Friday-available CFTC rows positioning_pressure=rolling_z(abs(noncommercial_net_pct_oi_combined-noncommercial_net_pct_oi),positioning_window), then align backward; insurance_interaction=rolling_z(implied_downside_gap,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(positioning_pressure)+0.5*tail_realization) clipped [-20,20]

expiry-conditioned end-of-day redesign, never dealer gamma or strike exposure: weight=clip((event_window-sessions_until_standard_expiry)/event_window,0,1); range_compression=-rolling_z(log(high/low),window); expiry_pinning=weight*range_compression; convexity_pressure=weight*rolling_z(VIX,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(abs(SPY_log_return),window))); quarterly_pressure=expiry_pinning*I(current_session_is_quarterly_expiry); reversal_pressure=weight*rolling_z(-sign(log(open/previous_close))*log(close/open),window)

realized Treasury-yield volatility proxy, never MOVE: across every available H15 yield maturity daily_curve_move=sqrt(mean(diff(yield_decimal)^2)); rate_volatility=sqrt(252*rolling_mean(daily_curve_move^2,window)); volatility_ratio=log(rate_volatility/(VIX/100)); divergence=rolling_z(rate_volatility,window)-rolling_z(VIX/100,window); shock=rolling_z(diff(rate_volatility,change_lag),window)-rolling_z(diff(VIX/100,change_lag),window)

historically available monetary-liquidity redesign: after conservative H.3/H.6 publication delays compute growth=diff(log(level),growth_lag) for monetary_base,total_reserves,M2 and rolling_z each over window; policy= -rolling_z(diff(effective_fed_funds_aligned_backward,growth_lag),window); net_liquidity=mean(base,reserves,money,policy); reserve_impulse=reserves; money_impulse=mean(base,money); policy_adjusted=mean(reserves,money,policy); no TGA, repo or RRP is claimed

after frozen H.8/H.6/commercial-paper publication delays compute growth=diff(log(level),growth_lag) and rolling z-scores over window for bank_credit,loans_and_leases,M2,commercial_paper; growth_breadth=mean(sign(raw growth)); credit_impulse=mean(z(bank_credit),z(loans),z(commercial_paper)); contraction_pressure=mean(max(-credit_z,0)); money_credit_gap=z(M2)-credit_impulse

causal first-release surprise redesign without survey consensus: separately for payroll,industrial_production,housing_starts,output,consumption, forecast_t=previous_release+mean(prior changes over forecast_window), error_t=actual_first_release-forecast_t, scale_t=std(prior errors over scale_window), standardized_surprise=error_t/scale_t; forward-fill only already published standardized states across release rows; surprise_breadth=mean(sign(states)), surprise_magnitude=mean(abs(states)), growth_surprise=mean(states), dispersion=population_std(states), requiring at least two available series

using only first-release CPI,core CPI,core PCE states, inflation_level=mean(latest published levels); for each series use the F098 causal forecast and prior-error scaling, inflation_surprise=mean(latest standardized surprises); inflation_trend=mean(latest rolling mean of release-to-release changes over forecast_window); inflation_acceleration=mean(latest change in those trends)

scheduled public FOMC decision proxy, never a fed-funds-futures surprise or text tone: emit only next-session decision events; policy_change=diff(effective_fed_funds between events); inflation=mean(latest first-release CPI,core CPI,core PCE), real_rate=effective_fed_funds-inflation; growth=mean(latest output_first,consumption_first); rule_rate=2+inflation+0.5*(inflation-inflation_target)+0.5*(growth-2), rule_gap=effective_fed_funds-rule_rate; event_interaction=0.5*(rolling_z(policy_change,normalization_window)+rolling_z(rule_gap,normalization_window))*(1+0.25*statement_flag+0.5*conference_call_flag) clipped [-20,20]

aggregate calendar redesign, never constituent announcements: e_change=diff(log(aggregate_earnings)) and d_change=diff(log(aggregate_dividends)); each seasonal prior is mean(value[t-12*k] for k=1..seasonal_window when known), earnings_news=e_change-prior_e and dividend_news=d_change-prior_d; news_seasonality=(rolling_z(earnings_news,window)+rolling_z(dividend_news,window))/2; quarterly_cycle=news_seasonality*cos(2*pi*(known_quarter-1)/4)

aggregate redesign, never analyst revisions or breadth: earnings_momentum=diff(log(aggregate_earnings),momentum_lag); earnings_yield_change=diff(earnings_yield,momentum_lag); acceleration=diff(earnings_momentum,momentum_lag); composite=mean(rolling_z(each of the three states,window))

aggregate earnings-dividend decomposition with no margin claim: earnings_growth=diff(log(aggregate_earnings),growth_lag); dividend_growth=diff(log(aggregate_dividends),growth_lag); payout_change=diff(payout_ratio,growth_lag); decomposition=mean(rolling_z(earnings_growth,window),rolling_z(dividend_growth,window),-rolling_z(abs(payout_change),window))

aggregate issuance proxy only, never buybacks or insider transactions: market_issuance=rolling_z(Goyal_ntis,window); align 13-month-delayed Z1 FA103164105.Q backward to each Goyal month, z1_issuance=rolling_z(diff(aligned_net_issuance,change_lag),window); agreement=(market_issuance+z1_issuance)/2; retirement_pressure=(max(-market_issuance,0)+max(-z1_issuance,0))/2

intermediary-capacity proxy, never firm dealer capital: for bank_credit,loans_and_leases,commercial_paper compute rolling_z(diff(log(level),growth_lag),window), credit_impulse=mean(the three); funding_stress=mean(rolling_z(financial_conditions_score,window),rolling_z(BAA_minus_AAA,window)); balance_sheet_capacity=credit_impulse-funding_stress; capacity_disagreement=credit_impulse+funding_stress

contemporaneous free-input redesign: compute rolling z-scores over window for uncertainty_score,volatility_level,absolute_rate_change and aligned financial_conditions_score; uncertainty_level is its z-score, stress_composite=mean(all four), disagreement=uncertainty_level-financial_conditions_state, persistence=rolling_mean(stress_composite,persistence_window)

recession-pressure proxy, never a published recession probability: on official Philadelphia vintage dates growth_state=mean(rolling_z(realtime_output_growth,window),mean rolling_z of latest first-release industrial_production,output,consumption); labor_state=-rolling_z(realtime_unemployment+unemployment_change,window); curve_state=rolling_z(yield_10y-yield_3m,window); recession_pressure=-(growth_state+labor_state+curve_state)/3

expectations proxy only, never consumer or business survey expectations: at first-release macro dates activity_state=mean rolling_z(payroll,industrial_production,housing_starts,output,consumption over window); uncertainty_state=rolling_z(latest uncertainty_score,window); expectation_proxy=rolling_mean(activity_state shifted one release,trend_window)-uncertainty_state; deterioration=-(activity_state-activity_state[t-trend_window]); disagreement=expectation_proxy-activity_state

quarterly public sentiment proxy, never analyst or retail surveys: align already available uncertainty,CFTC and contemporaneously public volatility backward to 13-month-delayed Z1 dates; allocation_state=mean rolling_z(household_equity_share,mutual_fund_equity_share,window); positioning_state=mean rolling_z(futures-only and combined noncommercial_net_pct_oi,window); uncertainty_state=-rolling_z(uncertainty_score,window); volatility_state=-rolling_z(vol30,window); sentiment_composite=mean(all four states); disagreement=population_std(all four states)

monthly WTI-gold redesign, with no copper claim: oil_gold_ratio=log(WTI/gold); oil_momentum=diff(log(WTI),momentum_lag), gold_momentum=diff(log(gold),momentum_lag); relative_momentum=oil_momentum-gold_momentum; inflation_impulse=rolling_z(oil_momentum,window); shock_divergence=rolling_z(oil_momentum,window)-rolling_z(gold_momentum,window)

broad-US industry proxy: cyclical_return and defensive_return are equal-weight means of frozen French 48-industry groups; cyclical_defensive_spread=rolling_sum(cyclical-defensive,window); leadership_breadth=rolling_mean(mean_sign_cyclical-mean_sign_defensive,window); rotation=rolling_z(cyclical,window)-rolling_z(defensive,window); dispersion_gap=rolling_mean(cyclical_cross_section_std-defensive_cross_section_std,window)

broad-US FF3 proxy, never S&P constituent leadership: size_leadership=rolling_sum(SMB,window); value_leadership=rolling_sum(HML,window); factor_rotation=rolling_z(SMB,window)-rolling_z(HML,window); market_confirmation=rolling_z(Mkt_RF,window)*sign((size_leadership+value_leadership)/2)

stock_return=diff(log(SPY_close)); Treasury duration-return proxy=-7*diff(yield10y/100); stock_bond_correlation=rolling_corr(stock_return,bond_proxy,window); curve_momentum=diff(yield10y-yield3m,momentum_lag); duration_momentum=rolling_sum(bond_proxy,momentum_lag); joint_shock=rolling_z(stock_return,window)+rolling_z(bond_proxy,window)

official H15 only: credit_stress=rolling_z(BAA-AAA,window); funding_stress=rolling_z(BAA-yield10y,window); policy_pressure=rolling_z(yield3m-effective_fed_funds,window); stress_composite=mean(the three)

currency redesign, never equity-session returns: calculate momentum_lag log changes; dollar_momentum=rolling_z(broad_dollar_change,window); safe_haven_rotation=mean rolling_z(JPY,CHF changes); cyclical_rotation=mean rolling_z(CAD,GBP changes); dispersion=cross_currency population_std of changes

industry common-mode proxy without constituent PCA: common_mode=equal_weight_industry_return; common_share=clip(rolling_var(common_mode,window)/mean_industry_rolling_variance,0,1); average_correlation=clip((N*common_share-1)/(N-1),-1,1); dispersion=rolling_mean(cross_industry_population_std,window)

industry breadth proxy: breadth=rolling_mean(mean(sign(industry_returns)),window); acceleration=diff(breadth,change_lag); spy_momentum=diff(log(SPY_close),window); divergence=rolling_z(breadth,window)-rolling_z(spy_momentum,window); failure_pressure=-sign(spy_momentum)*acceleration

redesign without constituent earnings breadth: build 20-session cyclical-defensive industry signal and align it backward to 13-month-delayed aggregate earnings dates; earnings_state=rolling_z(diff(log(aggregate_earnings),growth_lag),window); industry_state=rolling_z(aligned_industry_signal,window); alignment=mean(earnings_state,industry_state); leadership_gap=industry_state-earnings_state

declared causal state combination, not an outcome-fitted ensemble: on each SPY decision date construct rolling-z trend,industry breadth,FF3 market,10y-3m curve,-financial_conditions,first-release macro activity and negative public vol30 states over window; mean_forecast,median_forecast,consensus=mean(sign(states)),disagreement=population_std(states), requiring all seven states

causal analog search over the first features from the seven F119 states: at date t candidate j must satisfy j<=t-embargo and j+horizon<=t; select neighbors smallest Euclidean distances using only states known at t; emit neighbor_mean,neighbor_median,up_probability or neighbor_dispersion of already realized SPY log returns j to j+horizon; require embargo>=horizon

next-session SPY: prior_high=rolling_max(high.shift(1),window); prior_low=rolling_min(low.shift(1),window); high_distance=close/prior_high-1; low_distance=close/prior_low-1; range_position=2*(close-prior_low)/(prior_high-prior_low)-1; confirmed_breakout is +1 or -1 only after confirmation consecutive closes beyond the buffered prior range, otherwise 0

next-session SPY Wilder system: TR=max(high-low,abs(high-close.shift(1)),abs(low-close.shift(1))); plus_dm and minus_dm use mutually exclusive directional moves; DI=100*Wilder(DM,window)/Wilder(TR,window); ADX=Wilder(100*abs(plus_DI-minus_DI)/(plus_DI+minus_DI),window); Aroon uses argmax high and argmin low inside the completed rolling window; directional_strength=sign(DI_spread)*ADX/100

next-session SPY with adjust_false EMA: MACD=(EMA_fast-EMA_slow)-EMA_signal(EMA_fast-EMA_slow); PPO=100*(EMA_fast/EMA_slow-1)-EMA_signal(PPO_line); TRIX=100*diff(log(EMA_fast(EMA_fast(EMA_fast(close))))); TSI=100*EMA_fast(EMA_slow(diff(close)))/EMA_fast(EMA_slow(abs(diff(close)))); require fast<slow

causal next-session Ichimoku, never forward-shift: conversion=(rolling_max(high,conversion_window)+rolling_min(low,conversion_window))/2; base analogous; span_a=(conversion+base)/2; span_b uses span_b_window; divide conversion-base, close-cloud-midpoint and span_a-span_b by Wilder ATR; cloud_breakout is sign outside the contemporaneously known cloud; require conversion_window<base_window<span_b_window

next-session SPY: standard stateful Parabolic SAR with acceleration_step capped at acceleration_max and prior-two-bar clamps; standard recursive Supertrend final bands from Wilder ATR; Chandelier long=rolling_max(high,window)-atr_multiplier*ATR and short=rolling_min(low,window)+atr_multiplier*ATR; each score is close minus its causal level divided by ATR and consensus is the mean of their signs

closed prior-range levels only: H=rolling_max(high.shift(1),window); L=rolling_min(low.shift(1),window); C=close.shift(1); pivot=(H+L+C)/3; S1=2*pivot-H; R1=2*pivot-L; Fibonacci levels=L+{0.382,0.500,0.618}*(H-L); emit normalized pivot distance, S1-R1 position, four-bin Fibonacci position or signed distance to nearest frozen level

next-session SPY causal path transforms: Heikin-Ashi close=mean(O,H,L,C) and open_t=(HA_open_{t-1}+HA_close_{t-1})/2; Renko emits last brick direction using box_atr times prior Wilder ATR; Point-and-Figure uses the same prior box and close-only continuation or reversal after reversal_boxes; consensus is the mean sign, with no intrabar ordering assumption

deterministic trailing-window patterns only: triangle requires negative high slope and positive low slope; wedge requires same-sign high and low slopes with narrowing range; double_extreme compares first and final third extrema within tolerance around an opposite middle third and applies breakout_buffer; shoulders requires matching outer-third shoulders and a middle head separated by head_margin; all regressions and thirds end at the current observed close

next-session SPY: overnight=log(open_t/close_{t-1}); intraday=log(close_t/open_t); overnight_momentum and intraday_momentum are rolling sums; continuation=rolling_mean(sign(overnight)*intraday); gap_fill=rolling_mean(clip(-sign(overnight)*intraday/abs(overnight),-2,2)), assigning zero when overnight is zero

next-session SPY: Chaikin money flow=sum((((C-L)-(H-C))/(H-L))*V,window)/sum(V,window); centered MFI uses signed typical-price money flow; normalized Force Index=EMA(diff(C)*V)/EMA(abs(diff(C)*V)); normalized Ease of Movement uses midpoint change*(H-L)/V; Klinger uses recursive trend, DM and CM volume force then EMA_fast-EMA_slow minus its signal and scales by EMA_slow(abs(volume_force)); consensus is mean sign

trailing next-session log returns only: apply causal dilated Haar, db2, db4 or adjacent-block MODWT filters at scales 1..scales; energy_j=rolling_mean(detail_j^2,window); shares=energy_j/sum_j energy_j; emit first-scale high_frequency_share, final-scale low_frequency_share, normalized Shannon energy_entropy or max scale_concentration

trailing-only fixed-rule EMD: inside each completed return window find strict local extrema, linearly interpolate and extrapolate upper/lower envelopes, subtract their mean for sift_iterations, remove each IMF and repeat components times; EEMD averages the same endpoint over deterministic seeded Gaussian ensembles; emit standardized IMF1, IMF2, residual or absolute endpoint oscillation_share

rolling SSA on each completed return window: subtract the window mean; construct the embedding by K trajectory matrix; compute full SVD; endpoint contribution_k=s_k*u_k[-1]*v_k[-1]; trend=mean+component1, oscillation=sum selected components 2..components, residual=last return minus selected reconstruction, concentration=s_1^2/sum(s^2)

one-sided next-session decomposition: trend is rolling_mean(log_return,trend_window); for weekday, month and turn-of-month buckets estimate mean(return-trend) from matching observations in [t-window,t-1], requiring min_occurrences and explicitly exclude the current return; normalize every component by return volatility from [t-window,t-1]; combined=trend+the three prior-only seasonal components

causal trailing matrix profile at each t: query is the final subsequence; candidates must end before query_start-exclusion; raw or row-z normalized RMS distance selects neighbors; candidate continuation is return immediately after each candidate and is already observed before the query; emit nearest discord_score, fraction within radius, mean motif_follow_through or neighbor_dispersion

within each completed return window construct delay vectors of embedding coordinates, standardize each coordinate and mark Euclidean recurrence when distance/sqrt(embedding)<=radius, excluding self-links; recurrence_rate is recurrent share; determinism and laminarity are recurrent-point shares in diagonal or vertical runs of at least minimum_line; recurrence_entropy is Shannon entropy of qualifying diagonal lengths

on the cumulative path of each completed return window estimate generalized H(q) as the log-log slope of mean(abs(path_t-path_{t-lag})^q) over lags 1,2,4,8,16,32 divided by q; Hurst=H(2), roughness=mean absolute path increment/path standard deviation, fractal_dimension=2-H(2), multifractal_width=H(q_low)-H(q_high); sign by window direction and optionally reverse

causal empirical-EVT state: from the previous window only choose k=ceil(tail*window) largest absolute returns and threshold at rank k; tail_frequency is recent-quarter exceedance share minus tail; tail_magnitude=max(abs(r_t)-threshold,0)/past_sigma; stress_duration is consecutive current exceedances/window; hill_tail_index=1/mean(log(top_k/threshold)), capped at 20; sign by past 20-return direction and optionally reverse

next-session variance recursion initialized from rolling population variance: EWMA=decay*v_prev+(1-decay)*r_t^2; garch_proxy uses alpha=.8*(1-decay), beta=decay and omega=max(1-alpha-beta,0)*rolling_variance; asymmetric_ewma scales negative squared shocks by 1+asymmetry and adjusts alpha=(1-decay)/(1+.5*asymmetry); emit annualized volatility, r_t^2/v_prev-1 innovation, log downside/upside filtered variance or filtered/rolling variance gap

rolling causal AR threshold forecast: within each completed return window fit y=r_t on x=r_{t-lag} separately by x quantile regimes; SETAR selects the regime of the current return, STAR blends low/high predictions by logistic transition_speed, observable_threshold uses the selected regime historical mean; emit forecast/past_sigma, scaled regime_state, transition_probability or high-minus-low regime_spread; three regimes require threshold_quantile<0.5

at each refit t use only the prior window predictors and next-session log-return targets already known at decision t: AR regresses r[t+1] on r[t..t-p+1]; ARMA first fits that ridge AR, forms one-sided residuals and refits with q residual lags; distributed_regression additionally includes current and lagged log-volume changes; emit raw forecast, forecast divided by trailing target sigma, final known residual innovation or 1-MSE/variance fit quality

causal multivariate system over known SPY log return, log-volume change and joined VIX/VXO log change: VAR fits all three next-session changes on lags 0..p-1; VECM adds the current residual from the full trailing-sample regression log(SPY)=a+b*log(volume)+c*log(VIX); ridge system is refit only on prior rows and emits return forecast, forecast/residual sigma, standardized common state or error-correction state

core_causal_5 is exactly (F003,F015,F021,F032,F039), each as-of joined at or before the decision; at refit standardize the prior window, apply SVD, retain components principal loadings and orient each by prior same-session SPY-return correlation or positive F003 loading; emit weighted current factor score, retained explained share, reconstructed common direction or residual dispersion

causal quantile regression of already-known next-session SPY log return on current and lagged returns: standardize the prior window, solve the frozen 40-step asymmetric IRLS pinball approximation with ridge for tail, median, upper-tail and requested quantiles; monotonize low/median/high only for distribution diagnostics; emit requested quantile/sigma, interpolated P(return>0)-0.5, interquantile range/sigma or median skew/sigma

bounded least-squares SVM on core_causal_5=(F003,F015,F021,F032,F039): standardize prior window, select support_vectors deterministic equally spaced rows, construct linear, RBF or polynomial Gram matrix, solve alpha=(K+ridge*I)^-1*(y-mean(y)); emit forecast/sigma, tanh directional score, signed kernel-contribution alignment or maximum current support similarity

bounded deterministic tree ensemble on core_causal_5: random_forest bootstraps each prior-window sample and chooses the best of fixed 20/40/60/80 percent split candidates; extra_trees keeps all rows and draws three seeded thresholds per selected feature; every node samples max_features without replacement, stops at depth or min_leaf, and predicts leaf mean; emit ensemble forecast/sigma, direction vote, tree dispersion/sigma or average leaf support share

strongly regularized one-hidden-layer MLP on core_causal_5: standardize inputs and next-return target on each prior window, initialize deterministic seeded weights, train all weights and biases by frozen full-batch gradient descent for epochs using tanh or ReLU and L2 ridge; emit standardized forecast, centered direction probability, hidden-unit dispersion or bounded absolute model confidence

short causal temporal-convolution model over exactly five channels (known SPY return,F003,F015,F021,F032): form trailing sequence only, standardize channels on prior training sequences, apply seeded normalized tanh convolution filters with kernel and dilation at every valid past position, concatenate mean-pooled and endpoint activations, and learn a ridge next-return readout; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, endpoint-filter dispersion or endpoint/whole-path activation concentration minus one

reservoir_or_small_rnn over the same five causal temporal channels: standardize prior sequences, use seeded input weights and recurrent matrix scaled to spectral_radius; reservoir masks recurrent links to 20 percent density while small_rnn uses an orthogonal dense recurrent matrix; update tanh state with leak and fit only a ridge readout to known next returns; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, final state energy or cosine alignment between final and mean path state

compact causal attention or mixture-of-experts on core_causal_5 trailing lookback: standardize prior sequences; attention uses current query dot every past/current key divided by sqrt(5)*temperature, softmax context and ridge readout of query+context; MoE buckets prior sequences by volatility, trend or standardized hybrid gate quantiles and fits one ridge current-state expert per bucket; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, normalized attention entropy or cross-expert forecast disagreement

use the official current-vintage daily size portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(low-size)-return(high-size); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(low)-log1p(high)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily book-to-market portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-BM value)-return(low-BM growth); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(value)-log1p(growth)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily operating-profitability portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-profitability)-return(low-profitability); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(high)-log1p(low)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily investment portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(low-investment conservative)-return(high-investment aggressive); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(conservative)-log1p(aggressive)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior 12-to-2-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Hi PRIOR winner)-return(Lo PRIOR loser); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(winner)-log1p(loser)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior one-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Lo PRIOR loser)-return(Hi PRIOR winner); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(loser)-log1p(winner)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior 60-to-13-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Lo PRIOR long-term loser)-return(Hi PRIOR long-term winner); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(loser)-log1p(winner)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage monthly beta portfolios; treat YYYYMM as the completed month end and release it only at the tenth SPY session of the second following month; for 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-beta)-return(low-beta); over trailing W released months emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(high)-log1p(low)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5

use official current-vintage monthly total-variance and residual-variance portfolios, each released only at the tenth SPY session of the second following month; for 5 or 10 bins define each d=return(high-variance)-return(low-variance), apply the same four rolling statistics over W released months, then emit total, residual, their arithmetic mean, or total-minus-residual disagreement
